title: A germline KDM3C polymorphism impairs DNA repair and sensitizes to chemoradiotherapy.
publicationName: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
journalName: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
snippet: Chemoradiotherapy (CRT) is the standard-of-care therapy for many solid malignancies, yet predictive biomarkers of treatment response remain limited.
